title: A2A Task Delegation
description: Schema for delegating a scoped task from one agent to another, following A2A protocol principles.

delegator.description: Role or agent identity of the delegating agent.

assignee_role.description: Required role of the receiving agent.

task_description.description: Clear, self-contained description of the work to perform.

input_data.description: All context the assignee needs. Must be self-contained.

output_schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema the result must conform to.

success_criteria.description: Conditions that must be true for the task to be considered complete.

constraints.description: Boundaries the assignee must not exceed.

risk_tier.description: Level of rigor required for this task.

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time allowed for task completion.
